statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated
Diagnosis codes I25.10, I34.0, and R42 were submitted
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial was based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
